task: Create a 1-day meal plan for a lightweight endurance athlete with high caloric needs and no dietary restrictions.
solution_criteria: Plan includes at least 4 meals/snacks spread throughout the day
Total estimated calories are between 2800-3200 kcal for a 165cm, 55kg athlete
Meals emphasize carbohydrates and lean proteins suitable for endurance training
Plan is formatted concisely with meal times and brief descriptions

task: Create a 1-day meal plan for a heavyweight strength athlete aiming to build muscle while accommodating a vegan diet.
solution_criteria: Plan includes 5-6 meals distributed across the day to support muscle building
Total estimated calories are between 3200-3600 kcal for a 188cm, 95kg athlete
All protein sources are plant-based (legumes, tofu, nuts, seeds, plant proteins)
Meals are concise with sufficient protein density (targeting ~25-35g per main meal)

task: Create a 1-day meal plan for a sprinter focused on speed and power while avoiding dairy and gluten.
solution_criteria: Plan includes 4 meals/snacks optimized for high-intensity performance
Total estimated calories are between 2400-2800 kcal for a 178cm, 72kg athlete
All meals are both dairy-free and gluten-free with clear ingredient alternatives
Meals include adequate carbs and protein to support explosive athletic performance
